text: Active Customer is defined. Now we decide which of Veridian's data is sensitive enough to need a Purview Information Protection label, before a single scan runs.
Four tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Confidential-PII for anything that identifies a specific person financially -- each mapped to a real handling rule, not just a color.
We map where sensitive data is suspected to live, division by division -- Financial Services carrying the highest predicted concentration of customer SSNs and bank details.

The commitment that matters most: classification has to reach the real underlying base tables for every source, not only the curated reporting view a team is used to querying -- written down now, before a single scan touches Veridian's systems.
The plan is signed off. Next: SSMS -- registering and scanning all five sources for real.
